overall_explanation: No actionable P0–P2 defects were established in the staged change. Preflight is covered by the terminal backstop; CLI and embedded candidates share the admitted fallback and lifecycle owners; steering distinguishes non-steerable admissions from stale authority; cancellation and replacement preserve settlement ordering. Generated prompts retain hidden transcript custody. Current evidence reports 180 passing tests and guards. The prior 697-test run, full-build steps and scoped Gateway replay concern identical production blobs on the prior tree, not validation of the current upstream composition. Actual browser/provider append effects remain unproven, and the direct-route human-sentinel disappearance lacks a baseline comparison establishing a regression from this patch.
